# sendgrid_domain_authentication (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid authenticated domain by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_domain_authentication" "example" {
  id = "45373692"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The authenticated domain's numeric ID.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_security` (Boolean) Whether SendGrid automatically manages this domain's SPF record and DKIM keys.
- `custom_spf` (Boolean) Whether this domain uses a custom SPF record.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default authenticated domain.
- `dns_records` (Map of String) The DNS records required to authenticate this domain.
- `domain` (String) The domain being authenticated.
- `ips` (List of String) IP addresses included in this domain's custom SPF record.
- `region` (String) The region of the domain.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain used for this authenticated domain's DNS records.
- `username` (String) The username this authenticated domain is associated with.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether SendGrid has validated the required DNS records for this domain.
